up: List all approved drugs indicated for leukemia. Return the following columns for each drug-indication pair: the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the drug name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the EFO term ID for the indication (from drug_indication.efo_id), the indication label (from drug_indication.mesh_heading or efo_term), and the maximum phase for that indication (from drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind). Include all drugs with an approved indication for leukemia, regardless of the phase reached in other contexts. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, COALESCE(di.efo_term, di.mesh_heading) AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM drug_indication di JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Leukemia%' ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
